summary: Endava plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on September 18, 2026 the Board appointed Conor McShane of AlixPartners as Interim CFO, effective September 21, 2026, designating him principal financial and accounting officer. The move follows the Board's decision, on Audit Committee recommendation, to place CFO Mark Thurston on administrative leave effective September 21, 2026, pending an independent outside counsel investigation opened after the Company's auditors raised concerns over accounting treatment of certain customer and supplier agreements. Endava delayed Q4/FY2026 results and its Form 20-F, targeting filing by the November 2, 2026 SEC deadline; watch investigation findings, restatement risk, and auditor/control disclosures.
